text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Today is our team's first regular 
retrospective meeting. Curious to see the 
results of our "first step"?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I've compiled the evaluations during the 
Season. I'll be sharing them with the URA 
as well, so keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Building a winning team" is a must. The 
evaluation criteria emphasize "overall 
growth."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Even though there are individual 
differences, since we operate as a team, 
there's a baseline we definitely need to 
clear!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
How you interpret the results and plan 
around them is where you show your skill 
as a Trainer!
